content.en-US:
On December 18th, the "Digital Intelligence Leading the Way, Cloud Expanding Globally – 2025 Oracle China Innovation Summit," hosted by Oracle, was successfully held in Shanghai.  This summit brought together Oracle's global and China-based management teams, technology experts, and representatives from various industries to discuss the development path and innovative practices of enterprise-level technology systems in the AI ​​era.

![websoft9-oci-meet-1](https://libs.websoft9.com/Websoft9/resource/blog/2025/websoft9-oci-meet-1.png)

In the current era of rapid AI technology evolution and accelerated large-scale application, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), with its core characteristics of "highest performance, lowest cost, and most secure platform," continues to provide global enterprises with a stable, scalable, and future-proof cloud technology foundation.  At the conference, Wu Chengyang, Vice President and Managing Director of Oracle China, pointed out that AI has been deeply integrated into enterprises' core business systems, and cloud infrastructure is becoming a crucial cornerstone for the successful implementation of AI.  Leveraging its global network of over 50 regions, consistent technical architecture, and open ecosystem, OCI provides solid support for enterprises to build cross-regional, multi-cloud integrated AI-native capabilities.

![websoft9-oci-meet-2](https://libs.websoft9.com/Websoft9/resource/blog/2025/websoft9-oci-meet-2.png)

**Websoft9**, a key partner of Oracle in the field of application automation and operations, was invited to participate in the conference and signed an agreement on-site to become an Oracle "AI Capability Co-building Partner." This collaboration marks a crucial step for both parties in promoting enterprise cloud-native and intelligent transformation.  Notably, in August of this year, Websoft9, as the only invited Chinese company, officially launched its **Websoft9 Application Hosting and Intelligent Operations Platform** on the OCI Marketplace, further enhancing OCI's high availability and automated management capabilities at the application layer, helping enterprises efficiently transform cloud resources into business innovation drivers.

This platform focuses on core enterprise application scenarios, covering 90% of common business systems including databases, middleware, DevOps, and ERP.  Through visual workflows, it enables standardized management of the entire application lifecycle, from deployment and configuration to monitoring.  With its out-of-the-box application hosting capabilities and intelligent operation and maintenance system, Websoft9 helps enterprises quickly build stable and secure application environments on OCI, effectively reducing infrastructure complexity and allowing enterprises to focus more on business logic and the exploration of AI value.

As Oracle emphasizes—"The value of the cloud lies not in locking in customers, but in supporting them to go further"—the collaborative partnership between Websoft9 and OCI is a vivid embodiment of this philosophy. In the future, both parties will continue to deepen technological integration and ecosystem co-building, helping more enterprises achieve efficient and controllable digital transformation in the AI-native era.

title.en-US: Websoft9 2.3.0 Milestone Release: Unveiling a Single-Container Architecture & Fully Standalone Next-Gen Console!
title.zh-CN: Websoft9 2.3.0 重大发布：蜕变单容器架构，全新独立轻量化控制台重磅上线！

description.en-US: Websoft9 迎来 2.3.0 历史性版本！本版本彻底重构底层架构，正式告别 Cockpit 依赖，全面跨越至极简集约的单容器控制面板。全新 React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 打造的独立控制台闪亮登场，融合应用商店 v2、Web 文件管理器、浏览器 SSH 终端、高级代理 SSL 与备份，带给企业与开发者更纯粹、更轻量、更可靠的自托管应用管家。
description.zh-CN: Websoft9 leaps forward with 2.3.0! This historic release introduces a complete architectural overhaul, entirely eliminating Cockpit dependencies in favor of a lightweight, highly efficient single-container control plane. Equipped with a fully redesigned standalone console built on React 19, Vite, and MUI, Websoft9 brings modern App Store v2, in-browser Volume Files & Terminals, automated Proxy/SSL integrations, and scheduled backups to redefine self-hosting for developers and teams worldwide.

content.en-US:
### Introduction
As the enterprise demand for self-hosting open-source applications continues to rise, IT teams face major pain points in deploying, maintaining, and scaling hundreds of software suites reliably and easily.

Today, we are thrilled to announce that **Websoft9 v2.3.0 is officially released!**

This milestone introduces a major pivot. We have deprecated Cockpit-based system plugins, built a decoupled single-container architecture, and rebuilt the entire platform console to offer an ultra-smooth lifecycle management platform.

---

### 1. Architectural Evolution: Lean, Modular, and Independent

Before v2.3.0, Websoft9 heavily coupled with Red Hat's Cockpit host manager. While Cockpit was highly functional, its architecture limited our ability to run in purely containerized, cross-platform environments.

#### Drop Cockpit: Single-Container Control Plane
In this release, we have **fully retired the Red Hat Cockpit dependency and legacy plugins**.
* **Cohesive Containerization**: Core components (AppHub API engine, Console UI, Gitea GitOps server, Portainer, and Nginx Proxy Manager) now run synergistically inside **one** unified Docker container.
* **Supervisord Orchestration**: supervisord acts as PID 1, robustly maintaining and monitoring process health across all inner services.
* **Simplified Installer**: The entire installation and upgrade path has been shrunk down to a **single, unified terminal command**, shortening setup time significantly.

#### Brand-New Frontend Tech-Stack: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + MUI
Moving away from Cockpit custom plugins allowed us to construct a pure Web Console:
* Upgraded to the cutting-edge **React 19** with a lightning-fast Vite bundler.
* Introduced a complete component redesign with Material UI (MUI), featuring milliseconds-latency route hydration, polished telemetry charts, and seamless Dark/Light mode switching.

---

### 2. Powerful General Productivity Suite in v2.3.0

The Web Console now incorporates 7 productive tools, providing full lifecycle autonomy over applications:

#### App Store v2
* Features 200+ curated open-source templates (including WordPress, Odoo, ERPNext, etc.).
* Improved category filtering and keyword matching offer an intuitive SaaS-like marketplace feel.

#### My Apps (Unified Management)
* Manage all application lifecycles from one dashboard: Start, Stop, Restart, Redeploy, view real-time standard output logs, and troubleshoot config environments instantly.

#### Visually Integrated File Manager
* Traditional Docker host file transfers require manual SSH commands.
* We have introduced a web-based File Manager allowing users to upload, download, edit, copy, and modify mounting volume credentials natively inside the web portal.

#### Browser-Based SSH Terminal
* One-click terminal connection to underlying servers and container shells with responsive terminal resizing, color themes, and hotkey support.

#### Proxy & SSL Certificates
* Powered by close Nginx Proxy Manager orchestration, Websoft9 facilitates zero-config custom domain bindings and one-click Let's Encrypt SSL automation (including auto-renewals).

#### Automated Backups
* Protect your self-hosted databases and source codes. Start instant or scheduled backup jobs to local disks.

#### Setup Wizard & Platform Settings
* **Setup Wizard**: Out-of-the-box guide that initializes the admin authentication and defines platform port mappings.
* **Localization & Brand customization**: Seamlessly switch between English and Chinese (中文) while preserving customized logo assets easily.

---

### Conclusion & What's Next
Websoft9 2.3.0-rc.1 represents a massive leap forward in our quest to simplify self-hosting. By detangling our components from high-level OS layers, we provide you with a light, fast, and secure infrastructure environment.

With just a terminal shell and Docker installed, you can spin up Websoft9 today and experience the most streamlined, state-of-the-art self-hosting management tool center available.
content.zh-CN:
### 引言
随着企业自托管（Self-Hosted）开源应用的需求日益增加，如何低门槛、高效、安全地维护数百款开源软件成为了 IT 团队的关键挑战。

今天，我们激动地宣布：**Websoft9 v2.3.0 正式发布！** 

这是一个具有颠覆意义的版本。我们摧毁了过去两年基于 Cockpit 插件的运行模式，对底层架构和前端进行了一次“脱胎换骨”式的全面升级，为下一代企业级应用流转打下了高内聚、零依赖的坚实基础。

---

### 一、 核心升级：架构与性能的“脱胎换骨”

在 v2.3.0 之前，Websoft9 依赖 Red Hat Cockpit 作为宿主机管理层。虽然 Cockpit 功能强大，但它在容器化部署、跨平台兼容和深度定制化扩展方面存在先天局限。

#### 1. 彻底去 Cockpit 化：走向单容器控制平面 (Single-Container Control Plane)
在新版本中，我们正式 **移除了所有 Cockpit 依赖及旧版插件**。
* **全新集约化架构**：核心服务（包括 AppHub 引擎、Console 控制台、Gitea 提供 GitOps、Portainer、Nginx Proxy Manager 证书与反代）现在全部高度内聚地运行在**同一个 Docker 容器**中。
* **内置 Supervisord 监护**：由经典的 supervisord 作为一号进程，统一管理和维系单容器内所有后台服务的健康自愈与资源隔离。
* **极简一键式安装**：得益于极度集约的容器设计，新版本安装与升级全部融入了**单条命令一键式 Installer** 管道，安装速度提升数倍。

#### 2. 前端彻底回炉重造：React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + MUI
告别 Cockpit React 插件机制后，我们为 Websoft9 独立控制台（Console）量身定制了全新的前端技术栈：
* 采用最前沿的 **React 19**，完美结合 Vite 极速构建和 Material UI (MUI) 规范。
* 全新的加载首屏优化、完备的组件交互及丝滑的深浅色（Dark/Light）主题切换，操作响应达到毫秒级。

---

### 二、 2.3.0 生产力套件全面上线

基于全新控制台，我们正式推出了 7 款高频自托管生产力重磅组件，完全闭环自托管应用从部署、测试、维护到数据备份的全生命周期：

#### 1. 应用商店 v2 (App Store v2)
* 内置 200+ 精选开源应用模板（如 WordPress、Odoo、ERPNext 等），支持一键极速分发。
* 全新上线的分类过滤器、实时搜索，交互体验更符合企业级应用市场的直觉。

#### 2. 我的应用 (My Apps)
* 提供统一的应用状态看板。
* 您可以轻松在一页中对所有容器进行启动、停止、重启、智能重部署，一键提取实时容器日志并排查故障。

#### 3. 可视化文件管理器 (File Manager)
企业在维护 Docker 卷数据时通常需要 SSH 进去并用命令行操作。
* 2.3.0 内置了基于 Web 的文件浏览器，无需 SSH 即可在浏览器端对应用的容器挂载卷（Volumes）进行高吞吐文件上传、下载、纯文本编辑、权限调整和删除。

#### 4. 浏览器 SSH 终端 (Terminal)
* 原生支持浏览器内一键发起持久化会话的 SSH 终端，随时直连底层系统或容器，配合完美的色彩和快捷键支持，不逊于桌面端会话。

#### 5. 反向代理与免费 SSL (Proxy & SSL)
* 通过对 Nginx Proxy Manager 的高内聚整合，直接提供自主域名绑定、一键申请和监控 Let's Encrypt 免费证书，并能自动续期，一气呵成。

#### 6. 核心服务自动化备份 (Backups)
* 数据是自托管应用的第一生命线。新版本内置了应用与对应数据库的定时计划备份插件。
* 完美支持备份存放在本地宿主机。

#### 7. 引导向导 & 平台配置 (Setup Wizard & Settings)
* **首运行向导**：极简的初始化安装路径，在首次登录时一站式完成管理员初始化和底层端口映射设定。
* 支持一键切换中英文多语言，支持定制化企业专属 Branding 视觉。

---

### 三、 总结与未来展望
Websoft9 2.3.0-rc.1 代表了我们在简化自托管云原生应用部署和运营上的坚定信念。通过摆脱繁重的外部宿主机系统耦合，将底层归于极简的单容器，不仅让应用更轻盈，更赋予了 IT 团队 100% 的底层掌控力。

现在，您仅仅需要准备一台带有 Docker 的服务器，运行一行安装脚本，即可立刻体验迄今为止最现代化的自托管应用中心！

Effective immediately, the following applications have been **retired from the Websoft9 AppStore catalog**:

- **New installations are no longer available**. You cannot deploy or reinstall these apps through Websoft9 AppStore.

- Websoft9’s maintenance and support for these applications is discontinued. There will be no further updates, security patches, bug fixes or technical assistance.

### Security Recommendation
As Websoft9 will no longer maintain these offerings, potential upgrade security risks may arise. We strongly advise regular data backups and planning migration to actively‑maintained alternatives.

Websoft9 Team

### Websoft9 Earns Recognition in PeerSpot’s Prestigious PaaS Clouds Ranking Report, Joining Top Global Cloud Platform Vendors

*July 31, 2026* — Websoft9, the all-in-one self-hosted PaaS platform for simplified open-source application deployment and operations, today announced its official inclusion in PeerSpot’s widely referenced **[PaaS Clouds Buyer’s Guide (July 2026)](https://www.peerspot.com/categories/paas-clouds)** category rankings. The platform stands alongside established industry heavyweights Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS, Red Hat OpenShift, Google Cloud and Netlify Platform as a verified enterprise-grade Platform-as-a-Service offering tracked by the global PeerSpot tech professional community.

#### About PeerSpot’s PaaS Clouds Research

PeerSpot’s monthly PaaS Clouds ranking is built on real-world engagement data from over 900,000 IT architects, DevOps engineers, software developers and enterprise procurement leaders worldwide. The report evaluates PaaS vendors based on peer mindshare, user review volume, cross-cloud compatibility, core development tooling, vertical industry adoption and operational cost efficiency. As of August 2026, Amazon AWS holds the category’s highest mindshare at 13.8%, followed by Microsoft Azure at 12.3%, while Websoft9 has emerged as a differentiated alternative for organizations prioritizing self-hosting, open-source flexibility and low operational overhead.

#### What Makes Websoft9 a Distinct PaaS Solution in the PeerSpot Ranking

Unlike hyperscale public cloud PaaS offerings that demand complex DevOps expertise or container cluster management, Websoft9 delivers a streamlined, visual PaaS built around an integrated AppHub marketplace with **300+ pre-configured one-click deployment templates**, covering use cases spanning:
- Business collaboration & CRM (Odoo, Mattermost, EspoCRM)
- Data analytics & databases (PostgreSQL, Grafana, ClickHouse)
- Web & static site hosting (WordPress, Ghost)
- DevOps & CI/CD tooling (GitLab, Jenkins)
- AI/LLM open-source frameworks (OpenClaw, Dify, N8n, Ollama)

Built on Docker and GitOps native architecture, Websoft9’s core differentiators highlighted by enterprise users include:
1. **Zero-complexity application orchestration**
Teams eliminate weeks of manual environment setup; deploy production-ready open-source stacks in under 10 minutes via a unified web console, with automated domain binding, SSL certificate renewal, regular patching and one-click data backups. No advanced Kubernetes administration required for standard workloads.

2. **Full data sovereignty & multi-cloud portability**
Websoft9 runs natively on AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Alibaba Cloud and on-prem Linux servers. Organizations retain complete control of their application data without vendor lock-in, cutting SaaS licensing costs by 40–60% compared to equivalent managed third-party services.

3. **Cross-language custom app runtime support**
Beyond pre-built templates, the platform hosts custom code written in Python, Java, Node.js, PHP, Go, Ruby and .NET, with built-in resource auto-scaling, unified resource monitoring dashboards and role-based access control for distributed teams.

4. **Lightweight enterprise compliance readiness**
The platform meets GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance requirements, with container-level data encryption, centralized audit logs and configurable multi-factor authentication for admin access.

#### Vertical Industry Adoption Validated by Global Users
Per PeerSpot category segmentation, Websoft9 gains traction across key verticals that prioritize cost-effective self-hosted digital infrastructure:
- **Education**: Schools and universities deploy learning management systems, internal wikis and programming lab environments without dedicated cloud engineering teams
- **SME & Mid-Market Enterprises**: Small IT teams streamline internal CRM, project management and business analytics stacks
- **Fintech & Healthcare**: Compliance-focused organizations run secure, isolated transaction and patient data tools with full data ownership
- **Digital Agencies & Dev Shops**: Rapid client environment provisioning for websites, staging APIs and internal collaboration tools

#### Industry Commentary
> “PeerSpot’s PaaS ranking tracks solutions that solve real developer pain points, and Websoft9 addresses a clear market gap: most mid-sized teams want the power of cloud-native PaaS without the steep learning curve and operational overhead of hyperscale container platforms,” said the Websoft9 Product Lead. “Our inclusion in this respected global report validates our core mission—democratizing access to enterprise-grade application hosting so any business user, not just senior DevOps engineers, can deploy and manage production software independently.”

#### Next Steps for Evaluators & IT Teams
IT professionals researching PaaS alternatives via PeerSpot can access Websoft9’s vendor comparison pages against market leaders including AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Microsoft Azure App Service, Red Hat OpenShift and Netlify Platform within the PaaS Clouds category directory. Free technical trial deployments of Websoft9 are available on all major public cloud marketplaces, with full documentation, community support and enterprise subscription tiers with dedicated technical account management.

### About Websoft9
Websoft9 is an open-source, cloud-native self-hosted PaaS platform designed to simplify the full lifecycle of open-source application deployment, hosting and maintenance for enterprises of all sizes. Trusted by more than 30,000 organizations globally, the platform provides a unified visual console for one-click app provisioning, automated operations, cross-cloud portability and full data sovereignty, eliminating reliance on complex container orchestration workflows for small and mid-sized technical teams. Websoft9 is certified for deployment on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Oracle Cloud Marketplace.

### About PeerSpot
PeerSpot (formerly IT Central Station) operates the world’s largest peer-driven enterprise technology review platform, supporting over 900,000 IT professionals with unbiased vendor rankings, product comparisons and buyer’s guides across IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, cybersecurity and enterprise software categories. All rankings and mindshare metrics are derived from anonymous user engagement, product comparisons and verified solution reviews submitted by active enterprise IT practitioners.

### Websoft9 入选PeerSpot权威PaaS云平台榜单，跻身全球主流云平台厂商行列
*2026年7月31日* — 一站式自建PaaS平台Websoft9，专注简化开源应用部署与运维，今日宣布正式入选PeerSpot发布的 **[PaaS Clouds 2026年7月采购指南](https://www.peerspot.com/categories/paas-clouds)**。Websoft9与微软Azure、亚马逊AWS、红帽OpenShift、谷歌云、Netlify等主流企业级PaaS产品一同被纳入这份由全球技术社区跟踪收录的评测名录。

#### 关于PeerSpot PaaS Clouds榜单
PeerSpot月度PaaS榜单数据来源于全球90万+IT架构师、DevOps工程师、开发人员及企业采购负责人真实行为数据。榜单评估维度包含行业关注度、用户真实评价数量、跨云兼容能力、开发配套工具、行业落地情况以及综合运维成本。2026年8月数据显示，亚马逊AWS以13.8%行业关注度位居该分类第一，微软Azure紧随其后为12.3%；而Websoft9作为差异化方案，面向优先选择本地部署、看重开源自由度、希望降低运维负担的企业。

#### Websoft9 在榜单中的差异化核心能力
大型公有云PaaS通常要求使用者具备较高DevOps能力、熟悉容器集群运维；Websoft9主打轻量化可视化操作，内置应用市场提供**300+预配置一键部署模板**，覆盖多类业务场景：
- 协同办公与客户管理（Odoo、Mattermost、EspoCRM）
- 数据分析与数据库（PostgreSQL、Grafana、ClickHouse）
- 网站与静态站点托管（WordPress、Ghost）
- DevOps与CI/CD工具（GitLab、Jenkins）
- AI大模型开源框架 （OpenClaw, Dify, N8n, Ollama）

产品基于Docker+GitOps架构构建，企业用户重点认可四大核心优势：
1. **低门槛应用编排**
无需漫长环境搭建，通过统一Web控制台10分钟内即可上线生产级开源应用；自动处理域名绑定、SSL证书续期、系统补丁、一键备份。常规业务负载无需掌握K8s复杂运维。

2. **数据自主可控，支持多云迁移**
可部署在AWS、微软Azure、谷歌云、Oracle云、阿里云以及本地Linux服务器。企业完全掌握自身业务数据，无厂商锁定风险，对比同类SaaS服务可节省40‑60%软件授权成本。

3. **支持多语言自定义业务应用**
除预置模板外，支持Python、Java、Node.js、PHP、Go、Ruby、.NET等语言自定义代码托管；内置资源自动扩缩容、统一监控面板、面向团队的RBAC权限管控。

4. **轻量化企业合规适配**
满足GDPR、ISO 27001、SOC 2、HIPAA合规相关要求，提供容器层加密、集中审计日志、管理员多因素认证。

#### 多行业落地实践
结合PeerSpot行业统计，Websoft9在重视自建基础设施、控制成本的行业中得到广泛使用：
- **教育行业**：院校快速搭建学习系统、内部知识库、编程实训环境，无需专职云运维人员
- **中小企业**：小型IT团队快速落地内部CRM、项目管理、数据分析平台
- **金融科技、医疗**：对合规要求高的机构，实现业务隔离部署，保障数据所有权
- **数字服务商与开发团队**：快速为客户部署网站、测试环境、内部协同工具

#### 产品负责人观点
> “PeerSpot这份榜单聚焦真正解决开发运维痛点的产品。Websoft9瞄准一个明确市场缺口：大量中型团队希望拥有云原生PaaS能力，但不愿承担大型容器平台陡峭的学习曲线与运维压力。本次入选这份全球权威报告，印证我们的产品理念：让普通业务团队，而非只有资深DevOps工程师，也能够独立部署、运维生产级软件。” — Websoft9产品负责人
